_note: Bloc proposals, V1.3d. Shaped after the real Stability and Growth Pact and the Excessive Deficit Procedure, but the numbers are game numbers set by tools/bloc_probe.gd and not by the Treaties -- see docs/bloc-model.md. File order is the council's agenda: src/sim/bloc.gd rotates an index over the loaded list, so a proposal added here changes what comes up and when. V3.3 re-measured the council over 27 members: the authored positions produced unanimous or near-unanimous divisions in which no member's abstention could matter, so debt_reduction_rule's position was re-set by tools/ (the tally probe) to land the division inside the player's pivotal band -- 385 for of 639 cast against a 351.45 threshold, so France's 81 seats decide it whichever way they vote. V4.5b gave each row a sponsor and a decision class, and placed both by tools/council_probe.gd's table T rather than by feel. stability_pact (DEU, the 1997 pact's champion) and debt_reduction_rule (NLD, the frugal file) stay qualified majority. minimum_corporate_rate is UNANIMITY, because EU tax law is (Art. 115 TFEU), and its floor moved from 18 to 15: 15 percent is the real Pillar Two floor (Council Directive (EU) 2022/2523, adopted by unanimity after a holdout). The move was forced by measurement as well. At 18 the four low-rate members (BGR, CYP, HUN, IRL) vetoed at every position on the sweep grid and under every sponsor, which is a treaty nobody could ever carry. At 15 two vetoes remain, BGR and HUN, the fight the real directive had. The sponsor is DEU, not FRA: France is the player, a player-sponsored row gets no AI lobbying, and with France as sponsor CYP and IRL stay against.

proposals.name: Stability and Growth Pact
proposals.summary: Members undertake to hold the general government deficit under 3% of GDP. The Commission reports on those who do not, and the Council may levy a penalty.

proposals.name: Debt Reduction Rule
proposals.summary: A member carrying debt above 90% of GDP commits to a path back below it. The path is not enforced; the reporting is -- and the sponsorship is the green-liberal benches, whose fiscal hawkery is the debt brake's natural home in this council.

proposals.name: Minimum Corporate Rate
proposals.summary: A floor under corporation tax across the bloc, so that no member can compete for headquarters by cutting below it.
